text: A retired shop owner figured out how to beat the lottery in under two minutes.
Normally, if nobody matches all six numbers, the jackpot just keeps growing.
But in a game called WinFall, once the jackpot got big and nobody won, it was split between everyone who matched just a few numbers.
And matching a few numbers is easy, if you buy enough tickets.
Jerry did the math: those weeks, every hundred dollars of tickets paid back about a hundred and twenty.
So he bet twenty-two hundred dollars... and lost fifty.
He hadn't bought enough tickets. So he bet eight thousand, and won almost sixteen thousand.
He told his wife Marge, and she was in.
Friends and family chipped in, and they bought hundreds of thousands of tickets.
Then a newspaper spotted stores selling millions in tickets, and the state suspected organized crime.
Investigators found a retired couple... doing math. And it was all legal.
In the end, their group won nearly twenty-seven million dollars.
And they kept every ticket in tubs in their barn, in case of an audit.
